candidate.answerReason: The center is (0,0), and its perpendicular foot on x=5 is (5,0), giving distance 5.

methods.label: Measure the perpendicular segment
methods.explanation: The circle has center \(O=(0,0)\) and radius \(5\). Since \(x=5\) is vertical, the perpendicular from \(O\) meets the line at \(H=(5,0)\), giving distance \(OH=5-0=5\). This equals the radius, so the line is tangent to the circle; the requested distance is \(5\).
methods.levelReason: The method uses the standard circle equation and an elementary horizontal length in the coordinate plane.
